items.title: Student Dropout Early-Warning System
items.blurb: ML early-warning system for student dropout: 94.1% accuracy, 98% recall, deployed as a Flask web app.

details.summary: I built a machine-learning early-warning system that predicts which students are at risk of dropping out, using survey data from 35 universities across southwest Nigeria, and deployed it as a Flask web app.

blocks.title: The problem
blocks.text: Flag students at risk of dropping out early enough for support to reach them, across universities in southwest Nigeria.

blocks.title: The data
blocks.text: Survey data gathered from 35 institutions in southwest Nigeria.

blocks.title: The approach
blocks.text: I compared four models: a Logistic Regression baseline, Random Forest, XGBoost and a Soft Voting Ensemble.

blocks.title: The result
blocks.text: Random Forest performed best with 94.1% accuracy and 98% recall, so it catches almost every at-risk student. The model is served through a Flask web app.
